_meta.usage: the two-digit governorate code at the start of a current plate (11 A 12345) or just the code; old plates (before 2022 in Kurdistan, 2024 elsewhere) write the governorate name in Arabic instead: use `clues.py lookup admin <name>`
_meta.note: The code is where the vehicle was registered, not where the photo was taken. Codes 21–24 also show KR on the band.
_meta.miss_note: not 11–29: misread digits, an old plate with the governorate name instead of a code, or a foreign plate
source: https://ninanews.com/Website/News/Details?key=977300 (new governorate codes, 20 May 2022, cited by that article)
